lessons: Local structure-tensor tracing can follow the real dark-wave curvature, unlike prior generic Bezier paths.
A grayscale structure tensor fails in diffuse storm clouds (2/8 short paths then 0/8), so cloud motion needs region and chromatic structure first.
Foam needs continuous semantic carrier shapes, not only streamlines; coarse exclusion polygons are not enough for a global digitization.
